'''Sergei Leonidovich Mosyakin''' (born 30 November 1963) is a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] botanist.<ref name="Ed1993">{{cite book
  | title     = MEN OF ACHIEVEMENT 15ED 93-94
  | url       = https://books.google.com/books?id=1DloAAAAMAAJ
  | volume    = 15
  | date      = 1 January 1993
  | publisher = Taylor & Francis
  | pages     = 552–
| isbn=9780948875755 }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Born on November 30, 1961, in Kyiv.

From 1978 to 1983, he studied at the Kyiv State Pedagogical Institute (now known as the [[National Pedagogical Drahomanov University]]), specializing in Biology and Foreign Languages.

After completing his studies, he entered the graduate school of the Kholodny Institute of Botany.

From 1988 to 1991, he worked as a junior researcher, and since 1991, he has been the head of the Department of Plant Systematics and Floristics. Since December 2008, he has served as the director of the institute.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sergei Mosyakin |url=http://www.botany.kiev.ua/mosyakin.htm |access-date=2023-06-28 |website=www.botany.kiev.ua}}</ref>
